query:
SELECT 
            paid_at::text as "payout_at!",
            'group' as "source!",
            token_address,
            amount::text as "amount!"
        FROM payments
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            created_at::text as "payout_at!",
            'crowdfunding' as "source!",
            token_address,
            amount::text as "amount!"
        FROM withdrawals
        
        ORDER BY 1 DESC
